Original brief is W001-algebra.md Card A and its recommended next step (read full). For cubic f, C_v(f)=[X^(v-1)]f^((v-1)/2); elementary Frobenius proves C_pq=C_p C_q modpq. For f_t=(X+t)^3-(X+t), 3<p<q,p=3mod4,q=1mod4, random t gives proper factor p with probability>1/2. Both primes3mod4 fail identically. Computing C_N without factors is the entire missing primitive. Densepolynomials cost Omega(N), not polylog. At t1 C_N=d_m, m=(N-1)/2 centralDelannoy with genfun(1-6z+z²)^-1/2 and (m+1)d_(m+1)=3(2m+1)d_m-m d_(m-1). Existing Bostan–Gaudry–Schost sqrtindex machinery is prior art; denominators crossing prime factors are nonunits, factorialdivision invalid, exact integer numerator huge. Initial finite identity and155shift checks verified only reduction, no cost gain.

New task: supply or decisively reject ONE explicit normalized-block or binary-index coefficient extractor across nonunits. Attempt a real formula, not a faster-coefficient oracle. A block may return exact action or properfactor; charge all blocks, polynomialdegrees, gcds,widths, hidden characteristics. Check whether scalar Delannoy at t1 admits an index-doubling identity with a bounded auxiliary state, or a normalized transfer product can bypass factorial widths. Simple constant-matrix-overQ route ruledout by nonrationalgenfun, but not variable-index modular schemes. Fix own concrete restricted route, derive formulas, and compare total bound to N1/5 deterministic and heuristicGNFS, including translation/general-family gaps. If it fails, identify representation-specific obstruction and ONE materially different executable revision; do not simply posit compression. Only run tiny N91,143,187 comparisons acrossindices7,11,13,17 after an explicit formula exists. Preserve any negative cases. Output research/findings/H007-coefficient-extractor.md and optional H007-coefficient-* scratch next to it. Do not modify original report. No unproved general result may be promoted without later independent review.
